entries.title: Psalms 30:1
segments: ¶<A Psalm. A Song at the blessing of the House. Of David.> I will give you praise and honour, O Lord, because through you I have been lifted up; you have not given my haters cause to be glad over me.

entries.title: Psalms 30:2
segments: O Lord my God, I sent up my cry to you, and you have made me well.

entries.title: Psalms 30:3
segments: O Lord, you have made my soul come again from the underworld: you have given me life and kept me from going down among the dead.

entries.title: Psalms 30:4
segments: Make songs to the Lord, O you saints of his, and give praise to his holy name.

entries.title: Psalms 30:5
segments: For his wrath is only for a minute; in his grace there is life; weeping may be for a night, but joy comes in the morning.

entries.title: Psalms 30:6
segments: ¶When things went well for me I said, I will never be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 30:7
segments: Lord, by your grace you have kept my mountain strong: when your face was turned from me I was troubled.

entries.title: Psalms 30:8
segments: My voice went up to you, O Lord; I made my prayer to the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 30:9
segments: What profit is there in my blood if I go down into the underworld? will the dust give you praise, or be a witness to your help?

entries.title: Psalms 30:10
segments: Give ear to me, O Lord, and have mercy on me: Lord, be my helper.

entries.title: Psalms 30:11
segments: By you my sorrow is turned into dancing; you have taken away my clothing of grief, and given me robes of joy;

entries.title: Psalms 30:12
segments: So that my glory may make songs of praise to you and not be quiet. O Lord my God, I will give you praise for ever.
